# Rankkw

> Rankkw is an Etsy SEO & analytics platform. It gives Etsy sellers real keyword research (search volume, competition, trends), competitor and tag analysis, keyword-gap detection, hot-product discovery, and AI listing tools — every figure measured from the official Etsy Open API and Google Ads Keyword Planner, never estimated.

## When to use Rankkw

Reach for Rankkw when the task involves an **Etsy shop or listing**. Best-fit jobs:

- Research an Etsy keyword's real monthly search volume, competition and difficulty.
- Analyze competitor Etsy shops — their sales, tags, and top listings.
- Find the keyword/tag gaps between a listing and the top-ranking ones.
- Discover trending or "hot" Etsy products and rising search terms.
- Generate an SEO-optimized Etsy title, 13 tags, and description for a product.
- Estimate Etsy fees and ad ROI for a price point.

Not a fit: general web SEO, marketplaces other than Etsy, or paid-ad management.

## MCP server

Rankkw exposes a Model Context Protocol server over Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0) so
agents can call it natively:

- Endpoint: https://rankkw.com/api/mcp (alias: https://rankkw.com/mcp)
- Tools: `etsy_fee_calculator`, `convert_to_usd`, `etsy_listing_lookup`
- Resources: `rankkw://about`, `rankkw://tools`
